description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing price target data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameters, data models, and asynchronous data fetching logic.

classes.name: FMPPriceTargetQueryParams
classes.description: Model for FMP price target query parameters, allowing multiple symbols.

classes.name: FMPPriceTargetData
classes.description: Data model for FMP price target information, including optional news title and URL.

classes.name: FMPPriceTargetFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving price target data asynchronously from FMP API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an FMPPriceTargetQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw price target data for given symbols from the FMP API.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into a list of FMPPriceTargetData instances.
